content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the UCSL Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Degree in Mechanical or Electrical or Electronics or Electronics & Communication or Marine or Naval Architecture Engineering OR Minimum three-year Diploma in Mechanical or Electrical or Electronics or Marine or Shipbuilding Engineering. Minimum three/five years post qualification managerial experience in Procurement/Stores/Supply chain management in Shipbuilding/Ship repair/Offshore Fabrication/Petrochemical/Engineering/Government/Semi-Government Company.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for UCSL Assistant Manager (Materials) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the UCSL Assistant Manager (Materials) recruitment is 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Manager (Materials) post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Assistant Manager (Materials) position at Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Electronics & Communication, Marine, or Naval Architecture Engineering, or a three-year Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Marine, or Shipbuilding Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Assistant Manager (Materials) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Assistant Manager (Materials) post is 30 years as of 27th August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and 5 years for SC candidates. PwBD and Ex-servicemen also get relaxation as per GoI guidelines.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Manager (Materials) position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 40,000 to Rs. 1,40,000 per month, with an E1 grade salary of ₹ 80,280 per month.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General/OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General and OBC category candidates is ₹ 1000.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any application fees for SC/ST candidates?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for UCSL Assistant Manager (Materials) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an Objective Type Test, Certificate Verification, PowerPoint Presentation, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the UCSL Assistant Manager (Materials) recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official UCSL website on or before the last date of application, 27th August 2026.
